purpose: Pre-specify the W1 baseline-discrimination protocol after W0 feasibility, without allowing automatic curriculum promotion or mastery-rule changes.

prerequisite.w0_failure: W1 execution must not proceed when W0 is REVISE_PROTOCOL or INDETERMINATE.

sampling_and_assignment.assignment_rule: Every focal claim must receive the pre-specified task forms in its manifest task set, with planned variation recorded per task instance.
sampling_and_assignment.repeat_rule: Do not treat multiple attempts of the same administered instance as independent task instances.
sampling_and_assignment.randomisation: If randomisation or counterbalancing is used, record the assignment mechanism and preserve it in provenance.
sampling_and_assignment.exclusions: No post-hoc exclusion based on performance; exclusions must be pre-specified or documented as technical invalidity.

required_per_focal_claim.task_forms: At least two distinct task forms when the manifest specifies two or more.
required_per_focal_claim.variation: At least one planned variation relevant to the claim or its stated alternative explanations.

execution_requirements.registration: Use the standardized task-instance registration contract before administration.
execution_requirements.observation: Record one immutable raw observation linked to exactly one administered task instance.
execution_requirements.coding: Generate an uncoded C3 packet from the validated execution export; independent coders then create separate coding records.
execution_requirements.provenance: Learner, study, session, wave, task, registry version and administration timestamp must remain linked end-to-end.
execution_requirements.technical_invalidity: Technical failures are coded explicitly and do not silently become missing observations.

c3_requirements.adjudication: Separate from original independent coding records.

not_allowed: changing mastery rules from W1 alone

c5_boundary: W1 is baseline discrimination. It does not establish temporal precedence or prerequisite status. Repeated measurement or another explicitly justified longitudinal design is required for C5 ordering questions.

supabase.runtime_rule: If W1 is actually administered through persistent PacoGO runtime, perform a targeted PacoGO TEST persistence smoke test before accepting the runtime implementation. MAIN/LIVE remains untouched.
